name: @uiap/platform-proof-demo
description: A tiny independent module proving the SDK/event boundary without Core changes.

scripts.pack: npm run build && node -e "const AdmZip = require('adm-zip'); const zip = new AdmZip(); zip.addLocalFolder('dist', 'dist'); zip.addLocalFolder('web', 'web'); zip.addLocalFile('manifest.json'); zip.writeZip('platform-proof-demo.zip');"
